name: Atticus Earn & Protect: Lock in (demo placement)
description: Demo-only, local rendering on the venue's own positions page (ProphetX My Trades, Kalshi Portfolio, Novig Portfolio), in that venue's skin: a Lock in line under each open matched play, an inline panel with the terms, and a Protected chip once locked. Nothing is drawn before a trade. Pricing, the record and the hedge run in the Atticus event service; this extension holds no venue credentials and is placement only.
